title: Get to Know - Volume 1
description: Warm questions with no wrong answers, for a room that mostly knows each other.
attribution: Written for Mshikaki by the Innovations team

items.prompt: What is the last song you played twice in a row?
What is your go-to nyama choma order?
Which Kenyan town would you move to tomorrow, and why?
What is the most useless talent you have?
Which fictional character would you add to this team?
Matatu, boda or walk: what is your normal Nairobi commute?
What is the best meal you can get for 200 bob?
What is a film you can quote from start to finish?
Which food would you refuse to share, ever?
What is the last thing you fixed yourself?
Tea or coffee, and how many cups before 10am?
What is your favourite Kenyan proverb or phrase?
If you had one superpower at work, what would it be?
What is a small thing that made your week better?
What is the best advice you have been given by a colleague?
